rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides comprehensive GitHub repository management capabilities through the GitHub REST API, built by Sergey Kurdin using Node.js with the Model Context Protocol SDK and node-cache for performance optimization. It offers over 60 tools organized into categories including repository operations (listing, searching, content access), issue and pull request management with comment handling, branch and commit operations, file management with binary upload support, security features (webhooks, deploy keys, secrets), analytics and insights (traffic stats, languages, stargazers), search functionality across issues/commits/code/users, and organization management with team operations. The implementation features intelligent caching for analytics data, configurable tool restrictions, repository access controls, default repository settings, and supports both authenticated user operations and public repository access, making it valuable for developers, project managers, and DevOps teams who need AI-assisted GitHub workflow automation and repository analysis.
